definitions.explanation: A skin condition characterized by raised, itchy welts that appear suddenly. Caused by allergic reactions, stress, or other triggers.

examples.japanese: {蕁麻疹|じんましん}が{出|で}た。
{卵|たまご}を{食|た}べたら{蕁麻疹|じんましん}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: I broke out in hives after eating eggs.

examples.japanese: ストレスが{原因|げんいん}で{蕁麻疹|じんましん}が{出|で}ることもあるらしい。
examples.english: Apparently, hives can also be caused by stress.

notes:
USAGE:
{蕁麻疹|じんましん} is the standard medical and everyday term for hives. The kanji are difficult and rarely written; the word is most often written in hiragana (じんましん) or katakana (ジンマシン) in everyday contexts.

GRAMMAR:
The most common verb pattern is {蕁麻疹|じんましん}が{出|で}る (hives appear/break out). Note that Japanese uses {出|で}る (to come out) rather than a verb meaning "to get."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蕁麻疹|じんましん}が{出|で}る (to break out in hives)
- {蕁麻疹|じんましん}が{引|ひ}く (for hives to subside)
- {蕁麻疹|じんましん}が{治|おさ}まる (for hives to clear up)
